text:
The plate looks like a square side plate of about 24 cm. It holds 5 dark olives, probably Kalamata, and a small portion of chicken salad or tuna salad.

The olives are about 4 cm long, so each weighs roughly 6-8 g with the pit. Five olives come to about 35 g, or about 40 kcal.

The salad covers an area of about 8 x 6 cm and is lumpy. I estimate it at about 80 g. At roughly 200 kcal per 100 g for a mayonnaise-based chicken salad, that is about 160 kcal.

Together that is about 115 g and about 200 kcal.
